description: A consumer-class W-Engine launched by an exotic pet fan club to promote pet culture. It used to be a popular model until three customers' fingers, a staff member, and half a Bangboo disappeared into a Gourmet's big mouth. name: Puzzle Sphere
description: While it can be seen as an item to boost combat performance, it is also a uniquely shaped puzzle. The inspiration behind this W-Engine is said to have come from the designer's childhood, when a similar puzzle his mother made by hand helped him get through tired mornings and dreary afternoons. He poured his deep longing for his mother into the W-Engine and this longing brings the user a sense of comfort: holding the sphere is like returning to a childhood where, after a nightmare, you'd run to your mother's side for protection.
shortDescription: The W-Engine, with its bright colors and great performance, saw poor sales at first because it resembled a toy. But with its reasonable price, it slowly gained a positive reputation.

Even among the travelers who wander the Hollows, there are those romantic adventurers, poets of sorts, who go too far. "Radiowave Journey" is designed specifically for these romantic fools. Its additional radio module can convert Etheric frequencies into musical melodies, playing different styles of music depending on the type of Hollow you're in.

summary.desc: Designed for those Hollow-dwelling bards who refuse to listen to the same albums repeatedly, this W-Engine comes equipped with a radio module that can transform Etheric frequencies into melodies.

detail.name: Radiowave Journey
detail.desc: Not content with repeatedly listening to the same albums' melodies, and unwilling to stay stuck in the same Hollow scenery. Even among the travelers who wander the Hollows, there are those romantic adventurers, poets of sorts, who go too far. "Radiowave Journey" is designed specifically for these romantic fools. Its additional radio module can convert Etheric frequencies into musical melodies, playing different styles of music depending on the type of Hollow you're in.

name: Marcato Desire
description:
Art can save those drowning in life. Mortals gather together, music of different emotions collide, and the drying graffiti on the wall speaks of a thousand unique forms of agency.
Now, turn up the music until the soundwaves crash the Hollow. Even if Ethereals don't have ears, let's make them feel the power of humanity!
shortDescription: Gather 'round, mortals! Turn up the music!

name: Reel Projector
description: It's not surprising when a film student does something outrageous, but this fan of Hollow-themed films from the renowned New Eridu film school still drew a rebuke from W-engine craftsmen: "You DO know that W-Engines are for sound right, and not visuals?"
shortDescription: Clearly a W-Engine is for sound, and not images. What kind of lunatic genius would insist on stuffing a 16mm film camera into a W-Engine?

name: Demara Battery Mark II
description:
This customized W-Engine Core focuses on power storage and has been modified to enhance power storage functions. It can effectively boost Zap damage output for weapons, and is the gadget store owner's piece de resistance. Not long after, Anby made some tweaks based on user habits, but judging by how serious and careful she is while conducting each maintenance session, these are probably not the safest of modifications.

<color=#959595>"Weapons SHOULD be dangerous. If it can't shock me, then how is it going to shock the enemy?" — Anby's response while carefully performing maintenance</color>
shortDescription: A customized W-Engine that focuses on energy storage, modified to improve its energy capacity. This model is often used by Anby.

description:
This super-powerful support W-Engine, into which Ben installed extra heavy oil cylinders to keep it growling along, can even provide sufficient power for heavy-duty machinery. Despite its weight being so massive that ordinary people cannot lift it, for Ben, it's the perfect counterweight ball for his concrete pillar.

<color=#959595>"Don't worry. I've calculated the counterweight position and impact resistance factor down to four decimal places. It won't impact weapon performance." — Ben, before taking out his notebook to check over the calculations yet again</color>

name: Box Cutter
description:
This W-Engine's design was originally much more modest. The focus during its creation was on offensive capability and stealth until its owner met a group of curious and loud individuals who had no concept of subtlety. Not only did they put flashy stickers on it, but after injuring their fingers, they often used it to cut ropes, open boxes, and even slice through sticky tape...
"That... yeah, that box cutter, lemme borrow it, thanks!" "Boss, it's not a box cutter, it's called Hidden Claw!" "Hey, Kitty, lemme borrow your box cutter!" "It's not a box cutter, it's called Hidden Claw!" "Mind if lil ol me takes your box cutter for a mo?" "..."

<color=#959595>"Fine, it's a box cutter. Whatever makes you happy." — Pulchra</color>

detail.name: Box Cutter
detail.desc:
This W-Engine's design was originally much more modest. The focus during its creation was on offensive capability and stealth until its owner met a group of curious and loud individuals who had no concept of subtlety. Not only did they put flashy stickers on it, but after injuring their fingers, they often used it to cut ropes, open boxes, and even slice through sticky tape...
"That... yeah, that box cutter, lemme borrow it, thanks!" "Boss, it's not a box cutter, it's called Hidden Claw!" "Hey, Kitty, lemme borrow your box cutter!" "It's not a box cutter, it's called Hidden Claw!" "Mind if lil ol me takes your box cutter for a mo?" "..."

<color=#959595>"Fine, it's a box cutter. Whatever makes you happy." — Pulchra</color>

name: Tremor Trigram Vessel
description:
The art of acupoint is much like a chef in the kitchen. First, you explore the meridians, which is like rinsing the ingredients; then, you warm your palms, akin to heating the pan; and with two fingers pressing on the laughter point, the sound of laughter is like stir-frying. Practitioners must never recklessly strike a person's fatal point — it's like pouring hot oil into a stove, causing a disaster.

<color=#959595>"This little ball is darting between the acupoints, just like the fish balls I fling when making stir-fried noodles on the hot iron plate." —Pan Yinhu, distracted by random thoughts while doing acupoint memory training with a wooden panda sculpture.</color>
shortDescription: Pressing acupoints is like cooking. Striking the fatal acupoint is like setting the stove on fire, bringing disaster.

name: Grill O'Wisp
description:
Under the stars at midnight, the artisan raised this tool, awakening slumbering flames. Amid the misty dark, it was the lone flame that refused to die.
Its body gleamed black with a crimson sheen, etched with cryptic markings. Was it an ancient relic, a mere toy, or a legendary weapon? Only its wielder knew the truth.

<color=#959595>"It's nothing more than a fire-starting tool... but I can't deny it's useful." —So he would say, each time someone guessed it served some impressive function.</color>
shortDescription: A flame both fierce and faithful, burning without end.

name: Steel Cushion
description:
A supercomputing W-Engine equipped with an enhanced motion monitoring feature, perfectly matching the fast reflexes and combat maneuvers of Cat Thirens. Nekomata has added a foldable knife to its casing. Despite claiming that this design is to facilitate her in battle, the knife has fresh mackerel stains smeared onto it...

<color=#959595>"Lots of people call me a clever clogs for doing this mod, but when you're out on the streets, you gotta put everything you can to good use: Every little trick, every little thought, every little hustle... And look! A little kitty!" — Nekomata, diverting attention away while secretly trying to fish out the listener's wallet</color>
shortDescription: A supercomputing W-Engine equipped with a motion monitoring feature. Thanks to Nekomata's modifications, it perfectly matches the fast reflexes and combat maneuvers of feline Thirens.

name: The Brimstone
description:
A violent Obsidian Division W-Engine forged with fire and filled with a forbidden fuel that has been reprocessed using Ether-technology. Its intense heat can be used to clear the entire battlefield. Rumor has it that its designer was exchanging W-Engine design ideas with Soldier 11 over dinner. After an hour spent enjoying extra spicy noodles, she decided to bring extra spicy revenge to her enemies.

<color=#959595>"I really like it. It's stable, efficient, and practical. The high temperature can clean the battle residue off my blade and even disinfect wounds when needed... Why are you sitting so far away?" — Soldier 11, introducing her W-Engine to her teammates</color>
shortDescription: A W-Engine made for Soldier 11 by Obsidian Division. Its intense heat can be used to clear the entire battlefield.

name: Kraken's Cradle
description:
Most inspiration streaks by like a meteor, vanishing in a blink. Yet while modifying this W-Engine, a surge of powerful emotion sparked an idea that anchored itself in her mind, refusing to fade. Not a shackle, nor a consuming force, but something treasured — something she longed to keep safe. That became the source of this W-Engine's design.

<color=#959595>"It's simply trying to guard the greatest treasure in this world, in the way it knows how." —She spoke softly, noticing the puzzled expressions on the Proxy siblings.</color>
shortDescription: In chasing illusions, she was entranced by the light that pierced through the mist.

name: Tusks of Fury
description:
A multi-functional W- Engine specially designed with a motorcycle tire as the foundation. It boasts rapid speed, ferocious tearing power, solid defense, unexpectedly low energy consumption, and a domineering appearance. Apparently, this was initially just a toy that Big Daddy made for Caesar to play with, but every time Caesar played with it, it would end up in tatters. As a result, Big Daddy spent years reinforcing and modifying it over a hundred times, eventually creating this superb piece of equipment that can function as a weapon, shield, wheel, and even a light source.

<color=#959595>"It was originally supposed to also function as a piano, with keys embedded around the edge of the tire! But after a few tries, it didn't work out well. After spinning it a few times, I couldn't tell the correct notes apart, so I had to dismantle it... Fortunately, it can still be used as a fan when it gets hot." — Caesar, playfully flicking the W-Engine tire with her finger, whipping up a gust of wind.</color>
shortDescription: A versatile W-Engine based on a motorcycle tire that Big Daddy made for Caesar.

name: Hailstorm Shrine
description:
Slaughter is endless. Kill, conquer, the fate of the cursed, a restless forbidden power. Only between battles, when rushing to the next frontline, does the foxfire enjoy a brief reprieve in its shrine.
How many more corpses, how many more sacrifices, how many more calamities until we reach the void on the other side?
She needs no answer. At the peak of martial power, the stench of blood will freeze in the air before being breathed in. Once all evil is eradicated, the world will be able to enter peaceful slumber with the blade sealed.
Hail falls before the shrine, waking the wielder of this power. The blizzard is coming.

<color=#959595>"Perfect for training... If I could shrink to its size, that is." —Miyabi, muttering to herself as she gazes at the interior.</color>
shortDescription: Hail falls before the shrine, waking her. The blizzard is coming.

name: Flamemaker Shaker
description:
Powered by a specially formulated fuel, this modified W-Engine is optimized to push combustion performance to the extreme. The engine operates by injecting fuel from the tank into the reaction chamber, where a high-pressure reaction device converts the fuel into searing flames, leaving behind a scorched aroma. It's rumored Nitro-Fuel can also be used as a power source, as there was a sighting of Burnice pouring one into the tank, and later scraping the remaining liquid back into a bar glass after the battle.

<color=#959595>"This is definitely slander from a competitor. The special drinks I serve to my customers are always clean and hygienic! The Nitro-Fuel that drains out from the tank is for my own consumption because the high-pressure concentration gives it a special taste!" — Burnice, in defense of her professional reputation, oblivious to her customers unconsciously taking a step back.</color>
shortDescription: Modified by Burnice, this W-Engine uses a special fuel as its power source to boost combustion performance to the max.

name: Zanshin Herb Case
description:
Medicine is neither benevolent nor cruel. It merely heals what it must and brings its own side effects.
A warrior cares not how bitter and painful it may be to ingest. The ending is set in stone, so in order to shoot arrows that reach brighter places, he can do nothing but swallow them all.

<color=#959595>"There's a medicine that is real useful for faking sickness to get sick leave. If you don't take it with other stuff, it'll give you a brief fever. Unfortunately, it's pretty expensive, and it's not included in health insurance..." —Harumasa, sharing his insights into how to slack off.</color>
shortDescription: Bitterness and pain beget hope, and he devours them all.

name: Weeping Cradle
description:
A special W-Engine with multiple layers embedded inside. It contains a special Ether charging layer that can quickly recharge special-model Bangboo and custom-made combat equipment. name: Timeweaver
description:
A new model of supercomputing W-Engine custom-made by HSO Section 6, equipped with the most elite calculation and analysis functions, precisely records the user's time active and physical state to calculate the best plan of action. Embedded within is Yanagi's prized watch, but each time the W-Engine is turned on, the hands of the clock face go whirling around from the Ether energy, and it can no longer be used to accurately tell time. So, when she uses the time on here to tell you that you should hurry and be more efficient if you don't want to be late completing your mission, don't believe her.

<color=#959595>"So you're saying this is the ultimate weapon against time? I see, as the watch in the W-Engine moves so fast, the time it goes past is 'killed' so to speak, therefore it's a weapon against time... However, time in the real world does not actually change from this. No matter how fast the watch goes, it cannot kill time faster. Though the concept is decent, this punchline is only a six out of ten in my eyes." —Tsukishiro Yanagi, replying to her colleague's off-hand joke with complete seriousness</color>

name: Myriad Eclipse
description:
A refined collector, a cunning phantom thief, a loathsome swindler, an arrogant, self-important bastard...
The world has a thousand identities for him. The elite despise his very presence, while the common folk hail him as a symbol of justice. In the alleys, they talk of him as a criminal legend walking the razor's edge. Among nobles, speaking of him is like lifting the lid of a cursed tomb.
He wears a thousand masks — yet none reveal who he truly is.

<color=#959595>"I'll live on in a thousand different tales." — Hugo</color>
shortDescription: Shadowed by darkness at every step, he laid bare his heart to kindle a single, flickering flame.

detail.name: Myriad Eclipse
detail.desc:
A refined collector, a cunning phantom thief, a loathsome swindler, an arrogant, self-important bastard...
The world has a thousand identities for him. The elite despise his very presence, while the common folk hail him as a symbol of justice. In the alleys, they talk of him as a criminal legend walking the razor's edge. Among nobles, speaking of him is like lifting the lid of a cursed tomb.
He wears a thousand masks — yet none reveal who he truly is.

<color=#959595>"I'll live on in a thousand different tales." — Hugo</color>

name: Bellicose Blaze
description:
While developing this W-Engine, Captain Magus stood nearby repeating, "Not hot enough, not intense enough," pushing the maker to keep raising the temperature — right up to the brink of the material's melting point. The poor craftsman had to endure Magus's grumbling, Orphie's apologies, and suffocating steam to get the job done. Finally, with a sharp whine from the pressure, the special W-Engine emerged from its hellish forge — refined through fire and hammering, and cooled with a roar rivaling its master.

<color=#959595>"Captain, why are you always so angry?"
"I'm a gun, Orphie. All that flows through my chamber is metal and gunpowder."
—For the first time, Orphie saw a trace of sorrow in the weapon she called "Captain."</color>
shortDescription: She lingers by the banks of the Styx, waiting for the tide to extinguish the fury burning in her chamber.

Her life was one of seeking. Seeking companions, enemies, the truth, warmth. She reached out time and again, only to have it slip through her fingers. If one day she finds the missing fragments of her incomplete soul, will she be able to hear the melody in the wind once more?

<color=#959595>"Target has returned to the second floor of the video store. It sounds like they're preparing to sleep. Update on their location has been filed." — Trigger, apparently tracking and documenting a particular target.</color>
detail.desc2: Equip to increase Stun Agents' combat capabilities
detail.desc3: Broken eyes hold both resilience and vulnerability.

name: Qingming Birdcage
description:
Once a disciple of Yunkui, and now the sect leader.
Yunkui Summit has always upheld the duty of saving the world and helping others. Whenever Eridu faces disaster, a Yunkui disciple always steps up... until the day the old capital fell.
Time can allow new cities to rise and turn the old capital into ruins, but it cannot erase the past.
Though she traveled far and wide, trying to put the past behind her. Yet wherever she went, looking back, it always seemed as though everything was still right there in front of her.

<color=#959595>"Rivers may shift, but old dreams are hard to forget." —Yixuan</color>
shortDescription: The world is vast and full of change, and fate is unpredictable. But regardless of hardship or lack thereof, one must stay true to one's heart.

name: Roaring Fur-nace
description:
Goodbye to the fate of the past, goodbye to the childhood that slipped away so quickly, goodbye to my father's embrace and my mother's smile, goodbye to the claws and the stripes, goodbye to the unmoving mountains and the clouds that never linger, goodbye to my mentor and old friends, goodbye to me, goodbye to me.
As long as the world remembers, I once roared with courage.

<color=#959595>"Never fear! Your senior is here!" —  Fufu's line when coming to the rescue.</color>
shortDescription: The warm fire blazes through the long night, casting light on the tiger's roar in my heart.

name: Metanukimorphosis
description:
This compact mini W-Engine was just a budget unit issued for her first Hollow field training at school, but Yuzuha's kept it ever since — its compact size makes it too convenient to give up.
Her first modification boosted the W-Engine's power output. The second added two Ether-Anomaly-tuned components. The third attempted a rewiring of the internals, but caused a short circuit that burned a hole in her skirt. Manato helped with the fourth, repairing the heat conduction module damaged in the short circuit, though the meal she treated him to afterward cost enough to buy three new ones. The fifth upgrade installed a new resonance chamber, and the sixth improved its response to high-frequency signals from Drive Discs.
At last, it was perfect — a flawless, battle-ready device that could follow its owner through life and death! And yet—
"Dad, have you seen my W-Engine?"
"It's over there! I redid the casing for you. It looked way too ugly before! Can't have people thinking my daughter has no taste!"
"Dad! It's a W-Engine! You made it so flashy — what if it breaks?!"
"Well then, don't go doing stuff that could break it!"
shortDescription: A masterfully crafted design, infused with the creator's pursuit of beauty.

The long path ahead stretches on, and she grips her sword and presses forward, walking a path untrodden.
Until her blade flashes like a soaring swan, illuminating the clouds above.

<color=#959595>"Whenever I swing my sword, it grows warm... It's comforting." —Ye Shunguang</color>

name: Dreamlit Hearth
description:
Its origin cannot be dated, its craftsmanship beyond record. From appearance alone, it seems to be a relic of the old capital, preserved to this day by the Ether burning within its core.
Many years later, the river washed it ashore on a shallow bank, where a young girl picked up the finely crafted toy. From then on, it stood in for her lost family, keeping her company each night, offering a small light in the dark.

<color=#959595>"Yeah, it's a super great night-light!" —That's what Lucia said when asked.</color>
shortDescription: After countless years, it remains a silent puzzle.

name: Cordis Germina
description:
What is a "heart"?

What is the weight of life?

No matter how many machines she takes apart, no matter how many flowers she tends to, she still can't find the answer.

She programmed the W-Engine to mimic her heartbeat exactly, hoping it would lead her to an answer. But as the rhythm echoed, she slowly drifted to sleep. In her dreams, Seed Sr. came to life — with a heartbeat of his own — and once again responded to her wild, wandering questions, just like he used to...
Her journey continues along the long, endless circle.

<color=#959595>"Trigger's heartbeat is nice and steady. Soldier 11's is a bit fast. Orphie's picks up when the Captain scolds her, but it's kind of slow otherwise. As for you, Proxies~ Hmm, yours feels really intense?" —Seed, pressing an ear against the chests of the Phaethon siblings to listen to their heartbeats.</color>
shortDescription: Her journey continues along the long, endless circle.

name: Wrathful Vajra
description:
The Vajra with unquenchable rage — surely there's more to their cruelty than this. The warrior as steadfast as a mountain — surely there's more to their purity than this. The ascetic with a heart of flame — surely there's more to their suffering than this.

<color=#959595>"The craftsman was really fixated on the design of the lion's head... He said all the anger and courage were hidden in those eyes."
—Banyue, who can't help but think the W-Engine looks a bit too much like himself.</color>
shortDescription: The purging flames burned a hundred times, yet never cleansed me.

detail.desc:
The Vajra with unquenchable rage — surely there's more to their cruelty than this. The warrior as steadfast as a mountain — surely there's more to their purity than this. The ascetic with a heart of flame — surely there's more to their suffering than this.

name: Yesterday Calls
description:
Riiiing, riiing — every missed call from the Hollows will be answered by Krampus' top-tier customer service!
That playful line hardly captures the weight of old obsessions, grudges, and regrets carried through those calls. But in truth, it's the most earnest vow of one prepared to bear that burden.

<color=#959595>"Everyone else enters the Hollow armed to the teeth. Why am I the one carrying a bunch of phones?" —Dialyn, venting to her boss about her assigned gear.</color>
shortDescription: That call you never picked up... she's the one who answered it.

name: Thoughtbop
description:
Music is the girl's weapon against the world. The moment she puts on her headphones, she becomes a tiny hero on a quest to conquer the "Kingdom of Unhappiness," proudly swinging her sword and shield and ordering the world to release the treasured fantasies it keeps stingily hidden away.
But... every campaign runs into unexpected trouble now and then. Like that old friend who disguises herself as an angel while secretly being an evil demon queen — why is she always able to catch Sunna slacking off in some corner?!
"Hey, I went through all that trouble to help you assemble that W-Engine, and you're using it to slack off here?"
Sadly, this demon queen of unhappiness is far too powerful, and her arguments are always airtight... Every time this happens, the hero Sunna can only put down her weapon and scurry back to the practice room, once again locked in a battle of wits with those complicated dance steps she never quite manages to get right.

<color=#959595>"One day, I'll defeat the Demon Queen!" —a certain hero who dares not reveal their name.</color>
shortDescription: Thoughts follow the veins of fantasy, weaving themselves into song.

name: Neon Fantasies
description:
The neon disco light's misty shimmer intertwined with a playful angel's delusions, twisting into colors too blurred to name. Like every desire that can turn fatal, unpredictable and dangerous, yet no one could quite bring themselves to refuse.

Even seeing through the obsession behind the delusion wasn't enough to resist the temptation of sinking into it.

"If you say it looks like an octopus sausage, I'll turn you into one." — The captain of the Angels of Delusion, eyes blazing as she glares at a certain squad member.
shortDescription: A risky and unpredictable delusion that's impossible to refuse.

name: Serpentine Seeker
description:
Beneath the cold alloy scales, venom made of data flows. Each flick of the serpent's tongue probes the dark, carving out an electronic circuit that leads the homeless snake back to its "nest."

Each cycle of data in and out leaves untraceable fragments of corrupted code — much like its user, driven by instinct to chew through truth's rigid shell.

"It says... this time, the target's hiding somewhere nice and warm." — Cissia brushes a hand over the subtly warm serpent head, her smile hovering between danger and anticipation.
shortDescription: Digital venom flows beneath those alloy scales.

name: Starlight Rider Faceplate
description:
What is a knight?
The Crimson Knight says, "Carrying out the justice in my heart!"
The Amber Knight says, "Dealing with each sin in this world!"
The Verdant Knight says, "Protecting everyone's hope!"
So what is a knight, in the end? The advanced tactical construct suddenly falls into serious thought over this profound question, no different from the philosophers who have long pondered the ultimate meaning of existence.
Regrettably, this great and noble meditation on chivalric aesthetics is cut short in under ten seconds by an unceremonious interruption from a companion.
"Billy, you've watched 'Starlight Knight: A Knight's Proof' a hundred times already. So what even is the proof?"
"I'll know when I've watched it another hundred times!"
— Two people arguing over the remote at the Cunning Hares' base.
shortDescription: The proof of being a knight is within your grasp.

detail.name: Starlight Rider Faceplate
detail.desc:
What is a knight?
The Crimson Knight says, "Carrying out the justice in my heart!"
The Amber Knight says, "Dealing with each sin in this world!"
The Verdant Knight says, "Protecting everyone's hope!"
So what is a knight, in the end? The advanced tactical construct suddenly falls into serious thought over this profound question, no different from the philosophers who have long pondered the ultimate meaning of existence.
Regrettably, this great and noble meditation on chivalric aesthetics is cut short in under ten seconds by an unceremonious interruption from a companion.
"Billy, you've watched 'Starlight Knight: A Knight's Proof' a hundred times already. So what even is the proof?"
"I'll know when I've watched it another hundred times!"
— Two people arguing over the remote at the Cunning Hares' base.

name: Frostfall Sickle
description:
Clutching a wavering ideal.
Running and shouting across the barren red earth, then falling into sleep, only to wake up grown.
Choosing chains of one's own making.
Living on as a blade, scraping by. Investigating, interrogating, hunting... endless, numb, cold.
Waiting for the promised judgment.
Plucking a rotting new bud and stepping into winter, until at last welcoming life's final hope... death, warm and peaceful.
shortDescription: Carry out judgment until the end comes.
